name: com.atlasnet.unity
description: An entity-oriented Unity networking API with a local multi-worker backend for development demos.

samples.description: Import this first. Shared scripts, prefabs, primitive animation assets, and URP materials required by every AtlasNet sample.
Requires 00 Shared. Minimal host/join, owner movement, spawning, synchronized counters, and RPCs.
Requires 00 Shared. Owner-written movement and development dummy-backend worker handoffs.
Requires 00 Shared. Server-simulated movement, owner input, and development dummy-backend worker handoffs.
Requires 00 Shared. Server-authoritative rigidbodies, replicated poses, and applied impulses.
Requires 00 Shared. Adjustable entity count, interest boundaries, and development worker distribution.
Requires 00 Shared. Primitive animated players with owner-written movement parameters, network triggers, and late-join state.
Requires 00 Shared. Owner-simulated Rigidbody movement with kinematic server replicas, native/WebSocket clients, and worker handoffs.
